label: Agent Trace Timeline
description: What the agent did on a run — a waterfall of tool calls: the tool and its target per lane, a latency bar on a shared time axis, tokens per hop, and status colours for errors, retries and cache hits. Alpine card, composes at any canvas.

subtitle.label: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Line under the title. Empty = the run totals (calls · wall time · tokens).

spans.label: Spans
spans.description: The run's tool calls in order: tool, what it touched, start and duration in ms, tokens, status (ok · error · retry · cached). Up to 10 are drawn.

showTokens.label: Show tokens
showTokens.description: Print each span's token cost after its bar.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

anim.renderMode.label: Render mode
anim.renderMode.description: premium = alpha-fade; light = enable-gate pops (cheaper when nested).

anim.label: Animation
anim.description: Reveal: lanes appear in run order over the intro. reduceMotion renders the final frame.
